pages.title: Quantum Dot
pages.text: A nanocrystal small enough that its electrons are confined like those of a single atom, so it behaves as an artificial atom with tunable energy levels. Smaller dots glow blue, larger ones red: the colour is written by the size alone. A pinch of them looks like coloured sand that shines under any light.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Pressing Glowstone Dust against Cherenkov Quartz in the Casimir Vacuum Press shattered the dust into grains only nanometres across. Their glow had shifted colour by size, which told me the electrons were now trapped as in an atom.
